messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — I need a one-off admin window (2h) to run a data export from the prod read-replica for a customer analytics probe. It'll use infra.admin role.
Priya Rao: what specifically are you exporting? any PII?
Alex Chen: small set: event logs + user metadata for a cohort. emails + phone fields included but we plan to mask them before handing off.
Marta Silva: ok we need JIT approval + a short runbook. also confirm export goes to an encrypted bucket and that redaction is done before any download.
Alex Chen: runbook in progress, export will land in s3://redwood-temp-exports/<ticket>/, server-side encryption on. I'll mask emails with a regex replace during the dump.
Sam B.: FYI make sure KV cache + cached logs aren't included. Last time we missed a backup.
Priya Rao: please open a break-glass/JIT request in the portal and link it here. I can approve for 2 hours if Marta signs off on redaction plan.
Alex Chen: opened request JIT-5481: https://internal.redwood/tools/jit/JIT-5481 — added runbook and the s3 path.
eng-security-bot: JIT request created: JIT-5481 by Alex Chen — pending approver review.
Marta Silva: I reviewed the runbook. Need one change: remove "full_email" column from the export and include email_masked instead (sha256 prefix + "+@masked"), show example in runbook. Also add a post-run verification step to check no full_email in the bucket.
Alex Chen: will do. example SQL I plan to run:
```
COPY (
  SELECT id, event_time, user_id, CONCAT(left(email, 5), '...', '@masked') AS email_masked, other_fields
  FROM analytics.events
  WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
) TO 's3://redwood-temp-exports/JIT-5481/events.csv' WITH (FORMAT csv);
```
Priya Rao: looks good. Can you also add a command to delete the object after verification? retention needs to be <= 72 hours.
Alex Chen: added delete step to runbook and set lifecycle to 3 days.
Marta Silva: Approved for 2 hours starting 2026-03-17T15:30:00Z — conditions: audit logs enabled, export to encrypted bucket, verify redaction, post-run proof in JIT ticket.
Priya Rao: granting temporary role now via JIT. I'll post the time-limited creds in the portal. :white_check_mark:
eng-security-bot: JIT-5481 APPROVED by Marta Silva, approver=security_team, window=2h, expires=2026-03-17T17:30:00Z
Alex Chen: thanks — starting at 15:31 UTC. Will ping when dump finished and attach verification.
Sam B.: ping me if you need help with the lifecycle rule or bucket policy.
Alex Chen: dump finished, uploaded to s3://redwood-temp-exports/JIT-5481/events.csv, checksum attached to ticket.
Marta Silva: verifying now... verified: no full_email column present, sample rows look masked. :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: revoking JIT role in 10m.
eng-security-bot: JIT-5481 role revoked by Priya Rao at 2026-03-17T17:29:45Z
Alex Chen: confirmed access revoked, file lifecycle set, objects scheduled for deletion in 72h. thanks everyone.
Marta Silva: adding a short retro note to the ticket so we can tweak the template for next time (explicit mask example).
Priya Rao: thanks team. all clear.
